changelog: Fixed silent loss of distinct suspicious events that landed on the same second — the Suspicious sheet no longer dedupes by timestamp
Fixed the Live Map title-bar license badge, which read a property that was never written and could never fire; it now uses the same license state source as the in-page banner
Token-event fetch in the sync path now retries transient Reports API errors like the login fetch already did, preventing false sync aborts and re-fetch windows from growing
